66f51f3a0000000000000b01 description: I have a contact who keeps aircraft working around Tarkov. Calls himself Pilot. His dispatch link has gone quiet, and I need a few basic parts to restore the channel. Bring me two bundles of wires and two capacitors. Whatever you already have will do. Once the line is working, I will introduce you. He needs someone on the ground who can follow through.
66f51f3a0000000000000b01 startedMessageT: Two bundles of wires and two capacitors. Bring them here and I will get the dispatch channel working.
66f51f3a0000000000000b01 successMessageT: The channel is stable. Pilot is expecting you. He can arrange support, but you will need a handset paired to his network first. Talk to him about putting one together.
66f51f3a0000000000000b01 failMessageText: The work is still waiting. Come back when you are ready.
66f51f3a0000000000000b01 declinePlayerMe: I'll come back when I'm ready.
66f51f3a000000000000c102: Hand over 2 Bundles of wires to Mechanic
